ElectrLifecyclEmssnFctrSet.name: ElectrLifecyclEmssnFctrSet
ElectrLifecyclEmssnFctrSet.description: Represents the emissions factors used to calculate greenhouse gas emissions that occur throughout the lifecycle of electricity. It includes emissions from the production of electricity and losses during the transmission and distribution of each kilowatt hour (kWh) of electricity.

Country.description: The country where this electricity emissions factor set is valid.

EmissionFactorDataSource.description: The source of the emissions factor reference data.

EmissionFactorUpdateYear.description: The year when this reference data for the emissions factor was most recently updated.

ExternalIdentifier.description: The external ID of this emissions factor.

FuelCycleFactor.description: The greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions related to producing electricity from fuels, excluding direct emissions from burning the fuel.

FuelCycleFactorUnit.description: The unit for the greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions related to the fuel-cycle for producing electricity.

GenlCvsnFctrRevisionDate.description: The date when the electricity lifecycle emissions factor data is revised by the publishing authority.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

LifecyclTrnsmDstrFctr.description: The greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions related to all stages of electricity production and distribution, from fuel extraction to end-use, including loss of electricity during transmission and distribution of electricity.

LifecyclTrnsmDstrFctrUnit.description: The unit of the life cycle emissions related to the losses of electricity during transmission and distribution.

Name.description: The name of the electricity lifecycle emission factor set.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns this record.

ReferenceDataLoadLogId.description: The reference data load log record that's related to the emissions factor.

ShouldLockDtastUpdtForRec.description: Indicates whether the emissions factor set record can be locked from dataset editing.
